sources.entry: OSSEC | Open Source Host-based Intrusion Detection System

summary.one_liner: OSSEC is an open source host-based intrusion detection system (HIDS) that combines log monitoring, file integrity checking and SIM/SIEM-style analysis in one platform.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OSSEC as a full platform for monitoring and controlling systems, mixing host-based intrusion detection, log monitoring and SIM/SIEM functions. The screenshots shown in the README are labeled as file integrity monitoring and attack detection. Release downloads and documentation are hosted on the OSSEC website, and the development version is available on GitHub via git clone. The README gives no detailed feature list, installation steps, or configuration details. It also credits bundled third-party code, including modified zlib, parts of OpenSSL, and cJSON.
how_to_run: git clone the development repository from GitHub
Download stable releases from the OSSEC website (see Downloads and docs links)
notable: Combines HIDS, log monitoring and SIM/SIEM in one open source platform
Includes file integrity monitoring and attack detection
Annual OSSEC conference hosted by Atomicorp (per README)
caveats: README is brief and gives no install or configuration instructions; points to the external website for docs
Stable releases are distributed through the OSSEC website rather than GitHub
